[SWS_CM_10441] Failures in sending of a SOME/IP request message
⌈
If the send-
ing of the SOME/IP request message fails locally (in a way which is notified to the
ara::com implementation), the ara::com implementation shall make the Future
returned by the function call operator (operator()) of the respective Method class
(see [SWS_CM_00196]) ready according to [SWS_CM_10440].
⌋
